title: 第 15 章 月下独处遥遥相望第 16 章 残灵境成根基稳固
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 残道山谷的煞气渐渐平息，最后一缕煞灵王的余烟被风卷走，散入了夜空。
月亮已经爬到了天顶，清辉毫无遮挡地洒了下来，把整片葬神墓园照得纤毫毕现。之前浓稠的黑雾被两人的同调之力净化了大半，只剩下几缕稀薄的，绕着荒坟断碑缓缓流动，像一层薄纱，把这片禁地衬得格外清冷。
林寂回到了那块无字断碑下，盘膝坐了下来。
刚才和苏清砚联手打败煞灵王，又一起吸收了不少散逸的道韵，他体内的朽气已经稳了不少，只是刚才那股残道碎片里的记忆，还在他脑子里晃，那个黑衣男人的嘶吼，还有漫天的雷光，都让他心里沉甸甸的。
他没立刻修炼，只是垂着眸，看着自己的指尖。
刚才苏清砚说，她的净气能帮他压制封印，他当时只顾着激动，都没来得及想，这姑娘到底为什么要帮他？她是青云宗的圣女，天之骄女，而他是个人人唾弃的废人，是个被所有人当成邪修的异类，她为什么要冒着风险，帮他？
他想不通，也不敢想。
他从小就没人帮过他，爹娘抛弃他，同门欺负他，长老看不起他，他早就习惯了一个人扛着所有事，早就习惯了没人关心的日子。苏清砚的出现，像一道光，突然照进了他暗无天日的生活里，他怕这道光只是暂时的，怕自己抓不住，更怕自己会连累这道光，把她也拖进泥潭里。
他深吸了一口气，压下脑子里乱七八糟的念头，闭上了眼睛，开始运转体内的朽气，准备修炼。
丝丝缕缕的朽气从周围的泥土里、坟土里钻了出来，顺着他的毛孔，涌入他的体内，温和地滋养着他的经脉。他的呼吸渐渐平稳，心神也沉了下去，周围的一切都好像消失了，只剩下体内流转的朽气，还有丹田那团越来越稳的本源。
只是，他总觉得，有一道目光，落在他的身上。
很轻，很柔，没有恶意，也没有审视，只是安安静静的，落在他的背上，带着一点不易察觉的温度。
林寂的动作顿了一下，却没有回头。
他不用回头也知道是谁。
是苏清砚。
她没走。
刚才在山谷里，两人分开之后，他以为她会立刻回前山，毕竟后山是禁地，她一个圣女，待久了不好。可他没想到，她居然跟着他回来了，还站在不远处的崖边，就那么安安静静地看着他。
林寂的心跳，莫名的快了一点。
他能感觉到，她的气息，很轻，很稳，和他的朽气隔着几十丈的距离，隐隐的共鸣着。不用回头，他都能想象出她的样子，穿着素白的裙子，站在崖边，风把她的头发吹起来，月光落在她的脸上，清清冷冷的，像个不食人间烟火的仙子。
他没动，也没开口，只是继续运转着朽气，修炼着。
他知道，她也不想开口。
两人都有秘密，都有藏在心里的事，都怕一开口，就打破了这难得的平静，就暴露了自己的异常。所以他们只能这样，隔着几十丈的距离，一个在碑下修炼，一个在崖边静立，谁都不说话，却又都知道，对方在那里。
风轻轻的吹着，卷着荒草的碎叶，从两人中间吹过。
林寂的朽气，和苏清砚的净气，被风卷着，在半空中碰到了一起。没有冲突，没有碰撞，只是轻轻的缠了一下，然后又分开，像两个偷偷牵手的孩子，碰了一下，就赶紧缩了回去。
林寂的嘴角，不自觉的牵了一下，露出了一个极淡的笑容，快得连他自己都没察觉到。
他能感觉到她的情绪，很平静，还有一点淡淡的担心，担心他的朽气会反噬，担心李长老会回来找他麻烦。他也能感觉到，她的心里，和他一样，有一点孤独，有一点害怕，怕自己的秘密被人发现，怕自己被人当成怪物。
原来，她和他一样。
content_en:
The evil spirit in Candao Valley gradually subsided, and the last remaining smoke of the Evil Spirit King was swept away by the wind and dispersed into the night sky.
The moon has climbed to the zenith, and the clear light shines down without any obstruction, illuminating the entire God Burial Cemetery. Most of the previously thick black mist was purified by the synchronic power of the two, leaving only a few thin wisps, flowing slowly around the tombs and monuments, like a layer of gauze, making this forbidden land particularly cold.
Lin Ji returned to the broken monument without words and sat down cross-legged.
He and Su Qingyan had just teamed up to defeat the Evil Spirit King, and they had absorbed a lot of scattered Dao Yun together. The rotten energy in his body had stabilized a lot, but the memory of the broken Dao fragments just now was still lingering in his mind. The roar of the man in black and the thunder in the sky made his heart heavy.
He didn't practice immediately, he just lowered his eyes and looked at his fingertips.
Just now Su Qingyan said that her pure energy could help him suppress the seal. At that time, he was so excited that he didn't have time to think about why this girl wanted to help him? She is the saint of the Qingyun Sect, the proud daughter of heaven, and he is a useless person that everyone despises, an alien who is regarded as an evil cultivator by everyone. Why should she take the risk to help him?
He couldn't figure it out and didn't dare to think about it.
No one has helped him since he was a child. His parents abandoned him, his classmates bullied him, and his elders looked down on him. He has long been accustomed to shouldering everything alone, and has long been accustomed to the days when no one cares about him. The appearance of Su Qingyan was like a ray of light that suddenly shone into his dark life. He was afraid that this light was only temporary, that he would not be able to catch it, and even more afraid that he would implicate this light and drag her into the quagmire.
He took a deep breath, suppressed the messy thoughts in his mind, closed his eyes, and began to circulate the rotten energy in his body, preparing to practice.
Wisps of decaying air emerged from the surrounding soil and grave soil, flowing through his pores and pouring into his body, gently nourishing his meridians. His breathing gradually became steady, and his mind sank. Everything around him seemed to disappear, leaving only the rotten energy flowing in his body and the increasingly stable origin of his Dantian.
However, he always felt that there was a gaze falling on him.
It was very light, very soft, without any malice or scrutiny, it just fell quietly on his back, with a little bit of imperceptible warmth.
Lin Ji paused for a moment, but did not look back.
He knew who it was without looking back.
It's Su Qingyan.
She didn't leave.
Just now in the valley, after the two separated, he thought she would immediately return to the front mountain. After all, the back mountain was a forbidden area. She was a saint and it would not be good for her to stay too long. But he didn't expect that she would actually follow him back and stand on the edge of the cliff not far away, just looking at him quietly.
Lin Ji's heartbeat was inexplicably faster.
He could feel that her breath was very light and steady, faintly resonating with his decayed energy even though they were dozens of feet apart. Without looking back, he could imagine her appearance, wearing a plain white dress, standing on the edge of the cliff, the wind blowing her hair up, the moonlight falling on her face, cool and cold, like a fairy who does not eat the fireworks of the world.
He didn't move or speak, he just continued to circulate his rotten energy and practice.
He knew that she didn't want to speak either.
Both of them have secrets, both have things hidden in their hearts, and they are both afraid that if they open their mouths, they will break this rare peace and expose their abnormality. So they could only do this, separated by dozens of feet, one was practicing under the monument, and the other was standing quietly on the edge of the cliff. Neither of them spoke, but they both knew that the other was there.
The wind blew gently, carrying broken leaves of weeds and blowing between the two of them.
Lin Ji's decayed energy and Su Qingyan's pure energy were blown by the wind and met together in mid-air. There was no conflict, no collision, just a slight entanglement, and then they separated again, like two children secretly holding hands, touching each other, and then quickly retreated.
The corner of Lin Ji's mouth unconsciously twitched, revealing a very faint smile, so fast that he didn't even notice it.
He could feel her emotions, very calm, and a little worried, worried that his rotten energy would backfire, worried that Elder Li would come back to cause trouble for him. He could also feel that in her heart, just like him, she was a little lonely and a little afraid, afraid that her secret would be discovered and that she would be regarded as a monster.
It turns out that she is just like him.
title_en: Chapter 15: Alone under the moon, looking at each other from a distance Chapter 16: The foundation of the residual spirit realm is solid
